description: What a payload file is. An installer refuses a release containing a type it doesn't know. Add a type here before any release uses it.

payload_types.meaning: A raw image written to the unit's flash as-is, for example an MCU application or bootloader.
An ESP-IDF application image, written through the ESP-IDF OTA API into an inactive app partition.
A RAUC bundle, installed with RAUC into an inactive slot. RAUC checks its own signature in addition to this release's.
